What We Are About

Potential is everywhere. Opportunity is not.

Too many bright futures are cut short, not by a lack of talent or will, but by a lack of access: to education, to mentorship, to the opportunities that turn potential into lasting change.

The Nyaguthii Legacy Trust exists to close that gap. We invest in people, ideas and initiatives that create sustainable change, so that what we build today keeps opening doors for generations to come.

Why This Trust Exists

Built today, for a better tomorrow.

The Trust exists to create lasting and meaningful impact by investing in people, ideas, and initiatives that create sustainable change. We believe true legacy is built by empowering others to reach their potential.

This is not another organisation. It is a commitment to building something that continues creating opportunities, strengthening communities, and improving lives for generations.

01

Purpose-driven

Every decision is weighed against one question: will this strengthen the Trust for the next generation?

02

People-centred

We invest in individuals and communities, because empowered people build lasting change.

03

Trusted stewardship

Our ambition is not to be the largest trust, but one of the most trusted.

A Letter to Future Trustees

From the Founder

“I did not establish the Nyaguthii Legacy Trust simply to create another organization. I created it because I believe that a meaningful life is measured not only by what we achieve for ourselves, but by what we leave behind for others.

This Trust is my commitment to building something that will continue creating opportunities, strengthening communities, and improving lives long after my lifetime.

My hope is not that this becomes the largest trust, but one of the most trusted.”

Ann Nyaguthii GichukiFounder, The Nyaguthii Legacy Trust
The Founder's Charter

What we must never become

“The Trust must never become a vehicle for personal enrichment, political influence, or an institution that sacrifices ethics for convenience.”

Our decision-making principle: before approving any significant decision, we ask: will this strengthen the Nyaguthii Legacy Trust for the next generation?

Be part of a legacy that lasts.

Whether you wish to learn more, partner with us, or walk alongside our mission, we would be glad to hear from you.
